weakest_scene.root_cause: The hook and beat 0 share one scene, so the scene's build ran during the hook. By the time beat 0 says its number, the picture has already reached its end state. Data has no agent act tied to the dismantling.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Give beat 0 its own build: start at 70,300 warheads crowding the yard on the word '70,300', then have Data push or wheel carts into the DISMANTLING shed (an agent act on the moving part) so the stockpile visibly drains toward 12,500 as 'treaties pushed it sharply downward' is said. Drop the dashed ghost houses, or make them a clear then-vs-now silhouette, and keep the hook's picture different from beat 0's.
